Take notice that my client, Zenith Logistics LLP, has instructed our chambers to serve this formal demand. subject: CRITICAL: Potential customer lead data leak on unauthenticated webhook endpoint
body:
Dear Brightwave Security Team,

Our cybersecurity monitoring tool flagged a severe vulnerability this morning. The custom landing page webhook endpoint configured by your integration engineers (https://api.brightwavedigital.in/hooks/fintech-leads) appears to be returning unencrypted customer loan applicant records (names, phone numbers, and Aadhaar-linked application IDs) via public GET requests. This is a severe data breach and privacy violation under the DPDP Act 2023. We demand an immediate shutdown of this endpoint and a comprehensive forensic leak audit immediately.

Awaiting your emergency response,
Amit Joshi
Chief Information Security Officer, FinTech Bridge
